units.source_text: 这并非我的臆测，先生已经这样坦白了。

en.t: This was not my own guess; Sensei had already confessed as much.

units.source_text: 只不过他的坦白犹如山巅缭绕的云雾一般朦胧，在我的头上笼罩了难以名状的恐怖之物。

en.t: Only his confession was as hazy as clouds wreathing a mountain peak, and it cast over my head some indescribable thing of terror.

units.source_text: 而且，连我自己也不明白，这些坦白究竟为什么可怕。

en.t: Moreover, I myself could not understand why these confessions were so frightening.

units.source_text: 先生的坦白是朦胧的，却又显而易见地震撼着我的神经。

en.t: Sensei's confession was vague, yet it was plainly shaking my nerves.

units.source_text: 依据先生这种人生观，我也设想过先生或许有过一段惊天动地的热恋经历（当然是发生在先生和夫人之间），

en.t: On the basis of Sensei's view of life, I even imagined that he might once have had a passionate love affair that shook his world, of course between himself and his wife,

units.source_text: 联想到先生说过的“爱情即罪恶”这句话，多少算是个线索。

en.t: When I recalled Sensei's words that love is sin, they served, to some extent, as a clue.

units.source_text: 但是先生告诉过我，他很爱夫人，可见这种近于厌世的念头，绝不可能产生自他们两人的爱情。

en.t: But Sensei had told me that he loved his wife deeply, so this nearly world-weary idea could not possibly have arisen from the love between the two of them.

units.source_text: “曾经跪拜在对方面前的屈辱回忆，将使你把脚踏在他的头上”，

en.t: The humiliating memory of once kneeling before another person will make you set your foot upon his head,

units.source_text: 先生这句话只应该用在现代人身上，若用在先生和夫人之间似乎不太恰当。

en.t: These words of Sensei's seemed applicable only to modern people; applying them to Sensei and his wife did not seem quite appropriate.

units.source_text: 杂司谷的那个不知什么人的坟墓也常常出现在我的记忆中，我知道那个墓和先生有着很深的渊源。

en.t: The grave in Zoshigaya, whose occupant I did not know, also often came back to my memory, and I knew that the grave had a deep connection with Sensei.

units.source_text: 虽然，我不断地接近先生的生活，却又难以靠近，

en.t: Although I was continually drawing closer to Sensei's life, I still could not truly approach it,

units.source_text: 但作为先生记忆里的一个生命片段的那座墓却刻印在了我的脑海中。

en.t: Yet that grave, as one fragment of life within Sensei's memory, was engraved in my mind.

units.source_text: 然而，那座墓对我来说完全是死物，

en.t: However, to me that grave was something entirely dead,

units.source_text: 绝不会成为打开我和先生之间生命之门的钥匙，

en.t: and it would never become the key that opened the door of life between Sensei and me,

units.source_text: 它倒像是个伫立在我们之间的怪物，妨碍着我和先生的自然交往。

en.t: rather, it was like a monster standing between us, obstructing the natural intercourse between Sensei and me.
